$comment: Dynamic fixture — see schemas/conformance/README.md 'Dynamic fixtures'. The fields listed in dynamic_fields carry placeholders (__NOW*__, __VALID_*__, __JWS_*__); a conformance runner MUST mint fresh artifacts with the pinned KAT keypairs (PLACEHOLDERS.md) before execution. Static minting is not possible because the PoP exchange verifies a live nonce. The v0.2 `aud` claim equals `sub` per RFC-AITP-0005 §2 (the v0.1 fixture's audience pointed at the consuming peer; that invariant changed with the v0.2 claims model).
description: Happy-path downstream PoP exchange (RFC-AITP-0005 §6.1, §6.2). A consuming peer (agentA) issues a `pop_challenge` for a TCT it holds against subject agentB; agentB returns a `pop_response` whose `nonce_echo` matches the challenge nonce and whose `pop_signature` is `sign(agentB_priv, sha256(base64url_decode(nonce)))` with the subject key bound via the TCT's `cnf.jkt`. The runner MUST execute both steps and assert that the verifier (agentA) accepts the response. This fixture proves the implementation can produce AND verify a downstream PoP exchange end-to-end (the §6.2 conformance-note requirement). Whether an implementation *enforces* PoP for every grant is deployment-configurable; the *capability* tested here is mandatory.
